title: Why only 4% of Indian firms have AI-ready data
takeaways: Only 4% of Indian firms say their data is fully AI-ready.
58% of Indian firms call their data only partially ready.
63% of organisations lack or are unsure of AI data practices.
54% of Indian organisations struggle with data quality.
43% name data quality as the top barrier to production.
source_note: Sources: Dun & Bradstreet 2026; Gartner 2025; IDC 2025; Informatica 2025
